passages.text: “At that time Michael, the great prince who stands watch over your people, will rise up. There will be a time of distress, the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time. But at that time your people—everyone whose name is found written in the book—will be delivered.
passages.sermon:
Michael is a great prince.
Michael stands watch over your people.
At that time, Michael will rise up.
There will be a time of distress.
This distress will be greater than any since nations began.
At that time, your people will be delivered.
Everyone whose name is found written in the book will be delivered.
passages.original: וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִיא֩ יַעֲמֹ֨ד מִֽיכָאֵ֜ל הַשַּׂ֣ר הַגָּד֗וֹל הָעֹמֵד֮ עַל־ בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּךָ֒ וְהָיְתָה֙ עֵ֣ת צָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ נִהְיְתָה֙ מִֽהְי֣וֹת גּ֔וֹי עַ֖ד הָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וּבָעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ יִמָּלֵ֣ט עַמְּךָ֔ כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בַּסֵּֽפֶר׃

passages.text: And many who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, but others to shame and everlasting contempt.
passages.sermon:
Many people now lie dead in the ground.
They sleep in the dust of the earth.
One day, these people will awake.
Some of them will rise to everlasting life.
Others will rise to shame.
Others will rise to everlasting contempt.
passages.original: וְרַבִּ֕ים מִיְּשֵׁנֵ֥י אַדְמַת־ עָפָ֖ר יָקִ֑יצוּ אֵ֚לֶּה לְחַיֵּ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וְאֵ֥לֶּה לַחֲרָפ֖וֹת לְדִרְא֥וֹן עוֹלָֽם׃ס

passages.text: Then the wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
The wise people will shine.
Their light will be as bright as the sky.
Some people lead many others to do what is right.
These leaders will shine like stars.
They will shine forever and ever.
passages.original: וְהַ֨מַּשְׂכִּלִ֔ים יַזְהִ֖רוּ כְּזֹ֣הַר הָרָקִ֑יעַ וּמַצְדִּיקֵי֙ הָֽרַבִּ֔ים כַּכּוֹכָבִ֖ים לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃פ

passages.text: But you, Daniel, shut up these words and seal the book until the time of the end. Many will roam to and fro, and knowledge will increase.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Daniel.
God told Daniel to keep these words secret.
God told Daniel to seal the book.
Daniel must keep the book sealed until the time of the end.
Many people will travel here and there.
Knowledge will grow.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה דָֽנִיֵּ֗אל סְתֹ֧ם הַדְּבָרִ֛ים וַחֲתֹ֥ם הַסֵּ֖פֶר עַד־ עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ יְשֹׁטְט֥וּ רַבִּ֖ים וְתִרְבֶּ֥ה הַדָּֽעַת׃

passages.text: Then I, Daniel, looked and saw two others standing there, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet.
Daniel saw a vision.
Daniel looked.
Daniel saw two others.
These two others were standing.
One stood on this side of the riverbank.
The other stood on the opposite side of the riverbank.
passages.original: וְרָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל וְהִנֵּ֛ה שְׁנַ֥יִם אֲחֵרִ֖ים עֹמְדִ֑ים אֶחָ֥ד הֵ֙נָּה֙ לִשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְאֹ֔ר וְאֶחָ֥ד הֵ֖נָּה לִשְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃

passages.text: One of them said to the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, “How long until the fulfillment of these wonders?”
passages.sermon:
One man stood on one side of the river.
Another man stood on the other side of the river.
A man dressed in linen stood above the waters of the river.
One of the men spoke to the man dressed in linen.
He asked a question.
He said, “How long until these wonders are fulfilled?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לָאִישׁ֙ לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִמַּ֖עַל לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹ֑ר עַד־ מָתַ֖י קֵ֥ץ הַפְּלָאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and I heard him swear by Him who lives forever, saying, “It will be for a time, and times, and half a time. When the power of the holy people has finally been shattered, all these things will be completed.”
passages.sermon:
Daniel saw a man.
This man wore linen clothes.
This man stood above the waters of the river.
The man raised his right hand toward heaven.
He also raised his left hand toward heaven.
Daniel heard the man speak.
The man swore an oath.
He swore by Him who lives forever.
The man said, “It will be for a time, times, and half a time.”
He said, “When the power of the holy people is finally shattered, all these things will be completed.”
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֞ע אֶת־ הָאִ֣ישׁ׀ לְב֣וּשׁ הַבַּדִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִמַּעַל֮ לְמֵימֵ֣י הַיְאֹר֒ וַיָּ֨רֶם יְמִינ֤וֹ וּשְׂמֹאלוֹ֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּשָּׁבַ֖ע בְּחֵ֣י הָעוֹלָ֑ם כִּי֩ לְמוֹעֵ֨ד מֽוֹעֲדִ֜ים וָחֵ֗צִי וּכְכַלּ֛וֹת נַפֵּ֥ץ יַד־ עַם־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּכְלֶ֥ינָה כָל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃

passages.text: I heard, but I did not understand. So I asked, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
passages.sermon:
Daniel was a prophet.
Daniel listened to the message.
Daniel did not understand the message.
Daniel spoke to the man in linen.
Daniel said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אָבִ֑ין וָאֹ֣מְרָ֔ה אֲדֹנִ֕י מָ֥ה אַחֲרִ֖ית אֵֽלֶּה׃פ

passages.text: “Go on your way, Daniel,” he replied, “for the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end.
passages.sermon:
A man dressed in linen spoke to Daniel.
This man stood above the waters of the river.
He told Daniel to go on his way.
He said the words are closed up.
He said the words are sealed.
The words will stay closed and sealed until the time of the end.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ דָּנִיֵּ֑אל כִּֽי־ סְתֻמִ֧ים וַחֲתֻמִ֛ים הַדְּבָרִ֖ים עַד־ עֵ֥ת קֵֽץ׃

passages.text: Many will be purified, made spotless, and refined, but the wicked will continue to act wickedly. None of the wicked will understand, but the wise will understand.
passages.sermon:
Many people will be purified.
Many people will become clean.
Many people will be refined.
Wicked people will keep doing evil.
Wicked people will not understand.
Wise people will understand.
passages.original: יִ֠תְבָּֽרֲרוּ וְיִֽתְלַבְּנ֤וּ וְיִצָּֽרְפוּ֙ רַבִּ֔ים וְהִרְשִׁ֣יעוּ רְשָׁעִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יָבִ֖ינוּ כָּל־ רְשָׁעִ֑ים וְהַמַּשְׂכִּלִ֖ים יָבִֽינוּ׃

passages.text: And from the time the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation set up, there will be 1,290 days.
passages.sermon:
Daniel is the subject of this message.
God speaks to Daniel about future events.
The daily sacrifice will be abolished.
The abomination of desolation will be set up.
From that time, there will be 1,290 days.
passages.original: וּמֵעֵת֙ הוּסַ֣ר הַתָּמִ֔יד וְלָתֵ֖ת שִׁקּ֣וּץ שֹׁמֵ֑ם יָמִ֕ים אֶ֖לֶף מָאתַ֥יִם וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃

passages.text: Blessed is he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.
passages.sermon:
This passage speaks about a person who waits patiently.
This person endures until a specific time.
The time is 1,335 days.
God calls this person blessed.
God gives blessing to the one who waits and reaches the end of these days.
passages.original: אַשְׁרֵ֥י הַֽמְחַכֶּ֖ה וְיַגִּ֑יעַ לְיָמִ֕ים אֶ֕לֶף שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃

passages.text: But as for you, go on your way until the end. You will rest, and will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Daniel.
God told Daniel to continue on his way until the end.
God promised Daniel that he would rest.
God said Daniel would rise to receive his inheritance at the end of the days.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֖ה לֵ֣ךְ לַקֵּ֑ץ וְתָנ֛וּחַ וְתַעֲמֹ֥ד לְגֹרָלְךָ֖ לְקֵ֥ץ הַיָּמִֽין׃
